summary: The task is a single static top-view image, so PROC-GB-004 applies and replaces the multi-view criteria of PROC-GB-001 and PROC-GB-002. The approved reference was fetched (obs_02, matches_reference=true). The image (obs_01) is clear enough to judge the rim and interior. The glints, breaks in the orange reflection, the lower-left bright spot near 8 o'clock and the dark mark near 1-2 o'clock also appear in the reference. Position differences are consistent with small pose or lighting variation. The mottled grey-green band is also present in the reference. The comparison found no clear extra line, chip, gap, stain or foreign object, so neither GB-4 defect condition is met. The rim is continuous and the interior matches the reference pattern.
